_rationale: WA has no ordinary state tax. WA 7% LTCG kicks in only above the indexed threshold ($262k base @ 2024, indexed forward; in this 2026 scenario with 0% inflation it stays at $262k). Federal LTCG 15% applies to full gross. Withdrawal w solves: 0.85w − 0.07(w − 262000) = 400000 → 0.78w = 400000 − 18340 = 381660 → w ≈ $489,308. State LTCG ≈ 0.07·($489,308 − $262k) = $15,912. Federal LTCG = $73,396.
